title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2019
source: Source: BeyerDynamic M88's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with rich Beyer sound captures an energetic performance despite unknown setlist
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a great audience recording, highlighted for its surprising richness and clarity thanks to the Beyer equipment. No specific songs are mentioned, but the enthusiastic tone suggests a high‑energy, enjoyable show.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review lauds both the performance vibe and the audio quality; with no negative points the rating leans high, but confidence is limited by the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, full‑bodied sound noted as "richness of the Beyers," clear capture of crowd ambience with no reported flaws.
